name: @groundtruth-mcp/gt-mcp
description: Enterprise-grade MCP server for live docs, best practices, code audit. Context7 alternative — 445+ libraries, smart dispatch (use gt mcp), plain-text intent routing, telemetry, SSRF-hardened multi-source fetcher, atomic disk cache, IPv6 + Unicode-homoglyph defenses.

scripts.build: tsc && find dist -name '*.js.map' -delete && find dist -name '*.d.ts' -delete && javascript-obfuscator dist --output dist --compact true --string-array true --string-array-encoding rc4 --string-array-threshold 0.9 --split-strings true --split-strings-chunk-length 10
scripts.build:publish: node scripts/swap-private.mjs && npm run build; EXIT=$?; node scripts/revert-private.mjs; exit $EXIT
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build:publish && npm run update-stats
scripts.version: node scripts/update-version.mjs && node scripts/update-changelog.mjs && npm run update-stats && git add src/constants.ts CHANGELOG.md README.md server.json package.json llms.txt
scripts.postversion: git push && git push origin "v$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')" && node scripts/create-release.mjs
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm version minor && npm publish --access public && mcp-publisher publish
scripts.release:patch: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm version patch && npm publish --access public && mcp-publisher publish
scripts.release:major: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm version major && npm publish --access public && mcp-publisher publish

author: rm-rf-prod
